description.value: Donair Shack is a fast-casual restaurant specializing in authentic donairs — grilled meat carved from a rotating spit, wrapped in warm flatbread with fresh vegetables and house sauces. It is part of a small regional chain with five locations across Abbotsford, Mission, and Surrey, making it a familiar refuelling stop along the Fraser Valley corridor. The menu spans several donair styles, rice and salad platters, and falafel options, offering a filling and customizable meal for cyclists on the move.

OSM cuisine tag is 'sandwich', which is inaccurate — the business is a donair/Middle Eastern fast-food restaurant.
OSM has no phone number; 604-556-0596 was sourced from the website for the Abbotsford location.
